Name: --ref REF
Description: Path to the reference file.

Name: --out-vcf OUT_VCF
Description: Path of the VCF file after Variant Calling. (Allowed: .vcf, .vcf.gz)

Name: --in-tumor-bam IN_TUMOR_BAM
Description: Path of the BAM/CRAM file for tumor reads.

Name: --in-normal-bam IN_NORMAL_BAM
Description: Path of the BAM/CRAM file for normal reads.

Name: --in-tumor-recal-file IN_TUMOR_RECAL_FILE
Description: Path of the report file after Base Quality Score Recalibration for tumor sample.

Name: --in-normal-recal-file IN_NORMAL_RECAL_FILE
Description: Path of the report file after Base Quality Score Recalibration for normal sample.

Name: --interval-file INTERVAL_FILE
Description: Path to an interval file in one of these formats: Picard-style (.interval_list or .picard), GATK-style (.list or .intervals), or BED file (.bed). This option can be used multiple times.

Name: --mutect-bam-output MUTECT_BAM_OUTPUT
Description: File to which assembled haplotypes should be written. If passing with --run-partition, multiple BAM files will be written.

Name: --pon PON
Description: Path of the vcf.gz PON file. Make sure you run prepon first and there is a '.pon' file already.

Name: --mutect-germline-resource MUTECT_GERMLINE_RESOURCE
Description: Path of the vcf.gz germline resource file. Population VCF of germline sequencing containing allele fractions.

Name: --mutect-f1r2-tar-gz MUTECT_F1R2_TAR_GZ
Description: Path of the tar.gz of collecting F1R2 counts.

Name: --mutect-alleles MUTECT_ALLELES
Description: Path of the vcf.gz force-call file. The set of alleles to force-call regardless of evidence.

Name: --max-mnp-distance MAX_MNP_DISTANCE
Description: Two or more phased substitutions separated by this distance or less are merged into MNPs. (default: 1)

Name: --mutectcaller-options MUTECTCALLER_OPTIONS
Description: Pass supported mutectcaller options as one string. The following are currently supported original mutectcaller options: -pcr-indel-model <NONE, HOSTILE, AGGRESSIVE, CONSERVATIVE>, -max-reads-per-alignment-start <int>, -A <AssemblyComplexity>, -min-dangling-branch-length <int> (e.g. --mutectcaller-options="-pcr-indel-model HOSTILE -max-reads-per-alignment-start 30").

Name: --initial-tumor-lod INITIAL_TUMOR_LOD
Description: Log 10 odds threshold to consider pileup active.

Name: --tumor-lod-to-emit TUMOR_LOD_TO_EMIT
Description: Log 10 odds threshold to emit variant to VCF.

Name: --pruning-lod-threshold PRUNING_LOD_THRESHOLD
Description: Ln likelihood ratio threshold for adaptive pruning algorithm.

Name: --active-probability-threshold ACTIVE_PROBABILITY_THRESHOLD
Description: Minimum probability for a locus to be considered active.

Name: --no-alt-contigs
Description: Ignore commonly known alternate contigs.

Name: --genotype-germline-sites
Description: Call all apparent germline site even though they will ultimately be filtered.

Name: --genotype-pon-sites
Description: Call sites in the PoN even though they will ultimately be filtered.

Name: --force-call-filtered-alleles
Description: Force-call filtered alleles included in the resource specified by --alleles.

Name: --filter-reads-too-long
Description: Ignore all input BAM reads with size > 500bp.

Name: --minimum-mapping-quality MINIMUM_MAPPING_QUALITY
Description: Minimum mapping quality to keep (inclusive).

Name: --min-base-quality-score MIN_BASE_QUALITY_SCORE
Description: Minimum base quality required to consider a base for calling.

Name: --f1r2-median-mq F1R2_MEDIAN_MQ
Description: skip sites with median mapping quality below this value.

Name: --base-quality-score-threshold BASE_QUALITY_SCORE_THRESHOLD
Description: Base qualities below this threshold will be reduced to the minimum (6).

Name: --normal-lod NORMAL_LOD
Description: Log 10 odds threshold for calling normal variant non-germline.

Name: --allow-non-unique-kmers-in-ref
Description: Allow graphs that have non-unique kmers in the reference.

Name: --enable-dynamic-read-disqualification-for-genotyping
Description: Will enable less strict read disqualification low base quality reads.

Name: --recover-all-dangling-branches
Description: Recover all dangling branches.

Name: --pileup-detection
Description: If enabled, the variant caller will create pileup-based haplotypes in addition to the assembly-based haplotype generation.

Name: --mitochondria-mode
Description: Mitochondria mode sets emission and initial LODs to 0.

Name: --tumor-name TUMOR_NAME
Description: Name of the sample for tumor reads. This MUST match the SM tag in the tumor BAM file.

Name: --normal-name NORMAL_NAME
Description: Name of the sample for normal reads. If specified, this MUST match the SM tag in the normal BAM file.

Name: -L INTERVAL, --interval INTERVAL
Description: Interval within which to call the variants from the BAM/CRAM file. All intervals will have a padding of 100 to get read records, and overlapping intervals will be combined. Interval files should be passed using the --interval-file option. This option can be used multiple times (e.g. "-L chr1 -L chr2:10000 -L chr3:20000+ -L chr4:10000-20000").

Name: -ip INTERVAL_PADDING, --interval-padding INTERVAL_PADDING
Description: Amount of padding (in base pairs) to add to each interval you are including.

Name: --mutect-low-memory
Description: Use low memory mode in mutect caller.

Name: --run-partition
Description: Turn on partition mode; divides genome into multiple partitions and runs 1 process per partition.

Name: --gpu-num-per-partition GPU_NUM_PER_PARTITION
Description: Number of GPUs to use per partition.

Name: --num-htvc-threads NUM_HTVC_THREADS
Description: Number of CPU threads per GPU to use. (default: 5)

Name: --num-streams-per-gpu NUM_STREAMS_PER_GPU
Description: Number of streams to use per GPU. (default: 1)

Name: --verbose
Description: Enable verbose output.
Show full command line arguments.

Name: --logfile LOGFILE
Description: Path to the log file. If not specified, messages will only be written to the standard error output.

Name: --tmp-dir TMP_DIR
Description: Full path to the directory where temporary files will be stored. (default: .)

Name: --with-petagene-dir WITH_PETAGENE_DIR
Description: Full path to the PetaGene installation directory. By default, this should have been installed at /opt/petagene. Use of this option also requires that the PetaLink library has been preloaded by setting the LD_PRELOAD environment variable. Optionally set the PETASUITE_REFPATH and PGCLOUD_CREDPATH environment variables that are used for data and credentials. Optionally set the PetaLinkMode environment variable that is used to further configure PetaLink, notably setting it to "+write" to enable outputting compressed BAM and .fastq files.

Name: --keep-tmp
Description: Do not delete the directory storing temporary files after completion.

Name: --no-seccomp-override
Description: Do not override seccomp options for docker.

Name: --version
Description: View compatible software versions.

Name: --preserve-file-symlinks
Description: Override default behavior to keep file symlinks intact and *not* resolve the symlink.

Name: --num-gpus NUM_GPUS
Description: Number of GPUs to use for a run. (default: 1)
